messages:
maria_sales: Acme demo just hit 5xxs during ramp. On call now. Can ops triage?

tony_se: Which route/model and sample ids?

maria_sales: route `acme-poc-isolated`, model `redwood-edge-xl`. ids: a100, a101. Ramp 10->120 RPS in ~90s.

sam_support: Edge logs: [2026-09-10T12:01:11Z] id=a100 response=503 reason=burstpool_full; [2026-09-10T12:01:35Z] id=a101 upstream_error=attach_failed_quota.

oscar_oncall: Autoscaler attempted scale at 12:01:12; cloud returned quota_exceeded for preferred pool. Attach retried -> spot preemptions -> fallback to shared-burstpool. Burstpool queue hit max_conn.

tony_se: Short-term: set soft_limit_rps=45, fallback_model=redwood-edge-xl-quant, max_concurrency=1. Medium: move POC to reserved-small.

maria_sales: They want minimal quality loss. ETA for reserved-small?

oscar_oncall: Expedited ticket CH-13021 gives reserved-small in ~4-6h; normal is 24-48h. Cost uplift ~+25% for the POC week or we can apply a one-time credit.

infra-bot: Patch applied to route `acme-poc-isolated`: {soft_limit_rps=45,fallback_model=redwood-edge-xl-quant,max_concurrency=1} (patch-px77). 5xx rate dropped ~20% -> ~3% within 40s.

sam_support: Uploaded log bundle and credit note to the Deal record. maria_sales: please present mitigation + reserved option on the call.
